en: Colorized historic postcard view of a large, ornate military barracks complex with multiple pointed green roofs and towers along a riverside in an urban setting. In the foreground are trees, a quay with boats and barges on the river, sandy riverbank areas with carts, and a street with a red-and-white electric tram. The printed caption at the top reads in German: "Dresden" on the left and "Kaserne des 2. K. S. Jäger-Bataillons No. 13" on the right.
